title: A Four-Axis Trustworthiness Benchmark for LLM-as-Judge in Principle-Based Regulation
summary: A Four-Axis Trustworthiness Benchmark for LLM-as-Judge in Principle-Based Regulation｜Principle-based regulation, with evaluative standards such as "fair, clear, and not misleading"

extra.description: Principle-based regulation, with evaluative standards such as "fair, clear, and not misleading" or "deliver good outcomes", cannot be reduced to binary predicates, and LLM-as-judge is increasingly used as the substitute. Our position is that any such judge must be evaluated on four axes: accuracy, paraphrase robustness, adversarial robustness, and calibration.
